translations.literal: In the second year of Mingchang he was appointed tutor to Prince Bing and concurrently vice prefect of Datong Prefecture; soon he was changed to Pingyang and moved to defensive commissioner of Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Mingchang he became tutor to Prince Bing and vice prefect of Datong Prefecture, then was reassigned to Pingyang and made defensive commissioner of Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 轉運郭邦傑、節度李晏皆舉仲洙以自代。

translations.literal: Transport commissioner Guo Bangjie and military commissioner Li Yan both recommended Zhongzhu to succeed them.
translations.idiomatic: Transport commissioner Guo Bangjie and military commissioner Li Yan both recommended Zhongzhu as their successor.

sentences.zh: 升為定海軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to military commissioner of the Dinghai Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to military commissioner of the Dinghai Army.

sentences.zh: 歲饑，仲洙表請開倉，未報，先為賑貸，有司劾之，罪以贖論。

translations.literal: In a year of famine Zhongzhu memorialized to open the granaries; before a reply came he first distributed relief loans; the authorities impeached him; guilt was assessed as redeemable by fine.
translations.idiomatic: During a famine Zhongzhu memorialized to open the granaries. Before a reply arrived he issued relief loans on his own authority. The authorities impeached him, and he was fined in lieu of punishment.

sentences.zh: 時仲洙兄仲淵以罪責石州，仲洙上書請以萊易石，朝廷義而不許。

translations.literal: At the time Zhongzhu's elder brother Zhongyuan was penalized to Shizhou for a crime; Zhongzhu memorialized asking to exchange Laizhou for Shizhou; the court honored his righteousness but did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: At the time his elder brother Zhongyuan had been punished with assignment to Shizhou. Zhongzhu memorialized offering to swap his own post at Laizhou for Shizhou. The court admired his loyalty but refused.

sentences.zh: 久之，以年老乞致仕，累表方聽。

translations.literal: After a long while, citing old age he requested retirement; only after repeated memorials was he permitted.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he petitioned to retire on grounds of age, and only after several memorials was he allowed to do so.

sentences.zh: 泰和八年卒，年七十五。

translations.literal: He died in the eighth year of Taihe at age seventy-five.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eighth year of Taihe at the age of seventy-five.

sentences.zh: 仲洙性剛直，果于從政，尤長於治民，所在皆有功跡，蓋一時之能吏雲。

translations.literal: Zhongzhu was by nature upright and firm, resolute in administration, especially skilled at governing the people; wherever he served he left achievements—truly an able officer of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongzhu was upright and resolute in office and especially skilled at governing the people. Everywhere he served he left a record of achievement—one of the era's truly able administrators.

sentences.zh: 李完，字全道，朔州馬邑人。

translations.literal: Li Wan, styled Quandao, was a native of Mayi in Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wan, styled Quandao, came from Mayi in Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 經童出身，複登詞賦進士第。

translations.literal: Entering service through the classics-child route, he also passed the poetry-and-prose jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service through the classics-child route and later passed the poetry-and-prose jinshi examination as well.

sentences.zh: 調澄城主簿，有遺愛，民為立祠。

translations.literal: Assigned as registrar of Chengcheng, he left fond remembrance and the people built a shrine for him.
translations.idiomatic: As registrar of Chengcheng he won such affection that the people built a shrine in his honor.

sentences.zh: 用廉，遷定襄令，召補尚書省令史。

translations.literal: For integrity he was moved to magistrate of Dingxiang and summoned to fill a secretariat clerkship in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Recognized for integrity, he was promoted to magistrate of Dingxiang and then summoned to serve as a clerk in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 時以縣令闕人廉問，世宗選能吏八人按行天下，完其一也。

translations.literal: At the time with magistracies lacking men the court conducted an integrity inquiry; Shizong selected eight able officers to inspect the realm; Wan was one.
translations.idiomatic: When magistracies stood vacant and the court sought men of integrity, Shizong chose eight able officers to inspect the realm. Wan was among them.

sentences.zh: 明昌初，為監察御史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Mingchang he was investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Mingchang era he became an investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 故事，台令史以六部令史久次者補，吏皆同類，莫肯舉劾。

translations.literal: By precedent, censorate clerks were filled from long-serving clerks of the six ministries; the clerks were all of the same sort and none would impeach one another.
translations.idiomatic: By custom, censorate clerks were drawn from long-serving ministry clerks. Because they were all cut from the same cloth, none would impeach his fellows.

sentences.zh: 完言：「尚書省令史，正隆間用雜流，大定初乙太師張浩奏請，始純取進士，天下以為當。

translations.literal: Wan said: "Ministry of Works clerks, during the Zhenglong era, were taken from mixed streams; in early Dading, Grand Preceptor Zhang Hao memorialized, and they began to be drawn exclusively from jinshi degree holders—the realm thought this right.
translations.idiomatic: Wan said, "During Zhenglong, Ministry of Works clerks were recruited from mixed backgrounds. In early Dading, Grand Preceptor Zhang Hao memorialized that they should be taken only from jinshi graduates, and the realm judged that correct.

sentences.zh: 令乞以三品官子孫及終場舉人，委台官辟用。」

translations.literal: I now ask that sons and grandsons of third-rank officials and candidates who have completed the examination field be entrusted to censorate officials for selection and appointment."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that sons and grandsons of third-rank officials and candidates who have finished the examination field be recruited by censorate officials instead."

sentences.zh: 上納其言。

translations.literal: The emperor accepted his proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted his proposal.

sentences.zh: 擢尚書省都事，出為同知橫海軍節度使事、河間府治中。

translations.literal: He was promoted to chief clerk of the Ministry of Works and sent out as vice military commissioner of the Heng-hai Army and administrative aide of Hejian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to chief clerk of the Ministry of Works, then sent out as vice military commissioner of the Heng-hai Army and administrative aide of Hejian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 提刑司言：「完習法律，有治劇才，軍民無間語。」

translations.literal: The surveillance office reported: "Wan is versed in law, has talent for difficult administration, and soldiers and civilians alike speak well of him."
translations.idiomatic: The surveillance office reported, "Wan knows the law, has talent for heavy administration, and both soldiers and civilians speak of him without complaint."

sentences.zh: 升沁州刺史，仍以璽書褒諭。

translations.literal: He was promoted to prefect of Qinzhou and was further honored with an imperial letter of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to prefect of Qinzhou and received an imperial letter of commendation.

sentences.zh: 遷同知廣寧府。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice prefect of Guangning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice prefect of Guangning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 初，遼濱民崔元入城飲不歸，求得屍于水中。

translations.literal: Earlier a Liaobin resident named Cui Yuan went into town to drink and did not return; his corpse was found in the water.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier a Liaobin man named Cui Yuan had gone into town to drink and never returned. His body was found in the water.

sentences.zh: 有司執同飲者訊之，皆誣服，提刑司疑其冤，以獄畀完。

translations.literal: The authorities seized those who had drunk with him and interrogated them; all falsely confessed; the surveillance office suspected a miscarriage of justice and transferred the case to Wan.
translations.idiomatic: Officials arrested his drinking companions and interrogated them until all confessed falsely. The surveillance office suspected injustice and handed the case to Wan.

sentences.zh: 完廉得其賊乃舟師也，遂免同飲人。

translations.literal: Wan thoroughly investigated and found the culprit was a boatman; he then released the drinking companions.
translations.idiomatic: Wan traced the crime to a boatman and released the drinking companions.

sentences.zh: 改北京臨潢路提刑副使。

translations.literal: He was changed to vice surveillance commissioner of the Northern Capital Linhuang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was made vice surveillance commissioner of the Northern Capital Linhuang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 承安二年，遷陝西西路轉運使，尋授南京路按察使，卒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Cheng'an he was transferred to transport commissioner of the Shaanxi West Circuit, then appointed surveillance commissioner of the Southern Capital Circuit, and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Cheng'an he became transport commissioner of the Shaanxi West Circuit, then surveillance commissioner of the Southern Capital Circuit, and died in office.

sentences.zh: 完長於吏治，所至奸惡屏跡，民皆便之。

translations.literal: Wan excelled at administrative governance; wherever he went the wicked vanished and the people found life easier.
translations.idiomatic: Wan excelled at administration. Wherever he served, wrongdoers kept out of sight and the people benefited.

sentences.zh: 馬百祿

translations.literal: Ma Bailu
translations.idiomatic: Ma Bailu

sentences.zh: 馬百祿，字天錫，通州三河人。

translations.literal: Ma Bailu, styled Tianshi, was a native of Sanhe in Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Bailu, styled Tianshi, came from Sanhe in Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 父柔德，天會初第進士，累遷翰林修撰，坐田玨黨免官，迨世宗朝解黨禁，複召用焉。

translations.literal: His father Roude passed the jinshi in early Tianhui, rose to Hanlin reviser, was dismissed from office in the Tian Jue faction case, and when the faction ban was lifted in Shizong's reign was again summoned to service.
translations.idiomatic: His father Roude passed the jinshi in early Tianhui, rose to Hanlin reviser, lost office in the Tian Jue party case, and was recalled once Shizong lifted the faction ban.

sentences.zh: 百祿幼志學，事繼母以孝聞，登大定三年詞賦進士第，調武清主簿。

translations.literal: Bailu from youth aspired to learning, served his stepmother with filial piety that was widely known, passed the poetry-and-prose jinshi in the third year of Dading, and was assigned registrar of Wuqing.
translations.idiomatic: From youth Bailu devoted himself to study and was known for filial service to his stepmother. He passed the poetry-and-prose jinshi in the third year of Dading and was assigned registrar of Wuqing.

sentences.zh: 由龍山令召補尚書省令史，不就，改榷貨副使、平陽府判官，入為國子博士。

translations.literal: Summoned from magistrate of Longshan to fill a Ministry of Works clerkship, he did not accept; he was changed to deputy monopoly commissioner and prefectural judge of Pingyang, then entered service as erudite of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned from his post as magistrate of Longshan to serve as a Ministry of Works clerk, he declined. He became deputy monopoly commissioner and prefectural judge of Pingyang, then entered the Directorate of Education as an erudite.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以宰縣日清白有治跡，特遷官一階，升同知北京路轉運事。

translations.literal: Because in his days as county magistrate he had been upright and left a record of good governance, he was specially promoted one rank and made vice transport commissioner of the Northern Capital circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The court noted his upright record as a county magistrate and specially promoted him one rank, making him vice transport commissioner of the Northern Capital circuit.

sentences.zh: 委錄南北路刑獄，所至無冤。

translations.literal: He was entrusted to review criminal cases on the northern and southern circuits; wherever he went there was no injustice.
translations.idiomatic: Entrusted to review criminal cases on the northern and southern circuits, he left no wrongful convictions in his wake.

sentences.zh: 召為尚書戶部員外郎，與同知河北東路轉運事李京為中都等路推排使。

translations.literal: Summoned as assistant director in the Ministry of Revenue, he served with Li Jing, vice transport commissioner of the Hebei East Circuit, as household registration survey commissioner for the Central Capital and other circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned as assistant director in the Ministry of Revenue, he and Li Jing, vice transport commissioner of the Hebei East Circuit, were appointed household registration survey commissioners for the Central Capital and other circuits.

sentences.zh: 明昌初，遷耀州刺史，吏民畏愛。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Mingchang he was transferred to prefect of Yaozhou; officials and people both feared and loved him.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Mingchang he became prefect of Yaozhou, where officials and commoners alike feared and admired him.

sentences.zh: 提刑司以狀聞，授韓王傅、同知安武軍節度事。

translations.literal: The surveillance office reported his merits; he was appointed tutor to Prince Han and vice military commissioner of the Anwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: When the surveillance office reported his merits, he was made tutor to Prince Han and vice military commissioner of the Anwu Army.

sentences.zh: 俄改兼同知興平軍，以提刑司複舉廉，升孟州防禦使，再遷南京路提刑使。

translations.literal: Soon he was changed to concurrent vice commissioner of the Xingping Army; again cited for integrity by the surveillance office, he was promoted to defensive commissioner of Mengzhou, then again to surveillance commissioner of the Southern Capital Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made concurrent vice commissioner of the Xingping Army as well. Cited again for integrity, he rose to defensive commissioner of Mengzhou and then surveillance commissioner of the Southern Capital Circuit.

sentences.zh: 御史台以剛直能幹聞，轉知河中府。

translations.literal: The Censorate, hearing of his uprightness and competence, transferred him to prefect of Hezhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Known at the Censorate for uprightness and ability, he was transferred to prefect of Hezhong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 承安四年致仕，卒。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Cheng'an he retired and died.
translations.idiomatic: He retired in the fourth year of Cheng'an and later died.

sentences.zh: 諡曰貞忠。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Zhenzhong.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously titled Zhenzhong, "Loyal and Upright."

sentences.zh: 楊伯元

translations.literal: Yang Boyuan
translations.idiomatic: Yang Boyuan

sentences.zh: 楊伯元，字長卿，開封尉氏人。

translations.literal: Yang Boyuan, styled Changqing, was a native of Weishi in Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Boyuan, styled Changqing, came from Weishi in Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 登大定三年進士第，調郾城主簿。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi in the third year of Dading and was assigned registrar of Yancheng.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi in the third year of Dading and was assigned registrar of Yancheng.

sentences.zh: 升榆次令，召為大理評事，累除定海軍節度副使，用廉，超授同知河東北路轉運事，入為尚書刑部員外郎，以憂免，起為遼州刺史。

translations.literal: Promoted to magistrate of Yuci, summoned as reviewer of the Court of Judicial Review, repeatedly appointed vice military commissioner of the Dinghai Army; for integrity he was specially appointed vice transport commissioner of the Hedong North Circuit, entered service as assistant director in the Ministry of Justice, was excused on mourning, and was recalled as prefect of Liaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to magistrate of Yuci, then reviewer of the Court of Judicial Review and vice military commissioner of the Dinghai Army. Recognized for integrity, he was specially made vice transport commissioner of the Hedong North Circuit, entered the Ministry of Justice as assistant director, left office for mourning, and was recalled as prefect of Liaozhou.

sentences.zh: 明昌元年，移涿州。

translations.literal: In the first year of Mingchang he was transferred to Zhuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Mingchang he was transferred to Zhuozhou.

sentences.zh: 久之，擢工部侍郎，四遷安武軍節度使。

translations.literal: After some time he was promoted to vice minister of works and was transferred four times to military commissioner of the Anwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he was promoted to vice minister of works and, through four further appointments, became military commissioner of the Anwu Army.

sentences.zh: 泰和三年致仕，卒。

translations.literal: In the third year of Taihe he retired and died.
translations.idiomatic: He retired in the third year of Taihe and later died.

sentences.zh: 伯元以才幹多被委注，凡兩為推排定課使，累為審錄官，人稱其平。

translations.literal: Boyuan, for talent and competence, was often entrusted with duties; twice he served as household registration survey and tax-assessment commissioner, repeatedly served as case-review officer, and people praised his fairness.
translations.idiomatic: Talented and capable, Boyuan was repeatedly entrusted with important duties. He twice served as household registration survey and tax-assessment commissioner and often as case-review officer, and people praised his fairness.

sentences.zh: 每有疑獄，必專遣決，明辯多中理。

translations.literal: Whenever there was a doubtful case he was specially sent to decide it; his clarity often hit the mark.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever a case was doubtful, he was sent to decide it personally, and his judgments usually struck the truth.

sentences.zh: 賜諡曰達。

translations.literal: He was posthumously titled Da.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously titled Da, "Accomplished."

sentences.zh: 劉璣，字仲璋，益都人也。

translations.literal: Liu Ji, styled Zhongzhang, was a native of Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ji, styled Zhongzhang, came from Yidu.

sentences.zh: 登天德三年進士第。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi in the third year of Tiande.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi in the third year of Tiande.

sentences.zh: 大定初，為太常博士，改左拾遺，兼許王府文學。

translations.literal: In early Dading he was erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was changed to left remonstrance officer, and concurrently served as literary instructor to the Prince of Xu's household.
translations.idiomatic: In early Dading he was an erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, then left remonstrance officer and literary instructor to the Prince of Xu's household.

sentences.zh: 璣奏王府事，世宗責之曰：「汝職掌教道，何預奏事！」

translations.literal: Ji memorialized on a matter of the princely household; Shizong rebuked him, saying: "Your duty is to teach the Way—why meddle in memorializing affairs!"
translations.idiomatic: When Ji memorialized on a matter of the princely household, Shizong rebuked him: "Your duty is to teach the Way—why are you submitting memorials on administrative affairs?"

sentences.zh: 因命近侍諭旨永中曰：「卿有長史，而令文學奏事何也？

translations.literal: He then ordered a close attendant to convey the edict to Yongzhong: "You have a chief administrator—why let the literary instructor submit memorials?
translations.idiomatic: He then had a close attendant instruct Yongzhong: "You have a chief administrator—why let your literary instructor submit memorials?

sentences.zh: 後勿複爾。」

translations.literal: Do not do so again in future."
translations.idiomatic: Do not let this happen again."

sentences.zh: 累除同知漕運司事，嘗奏言：「漕戶顧直太高，虛費官物，宜約量裁損。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly appointed vice commissioner of the Grain Transport Office and once memorialized: "The hire paid transport households is too high and wastes government goods; the amount should be measured and reduced.
translations.idiomatic: After several appointments as vice commissioner of the Grain Transport Office, he once memorialized, "Transport households are paid too generously, wasting state resources. The allowance should be measured and cut.

sentences.zh: 若減三之一，歲可省官錢一十五萬餘貫。」

translations.literal: If reduced by one third, more than one hundred fifty thousand strings of official cash could be saved each year."
translations.idiomatic: Cutting it by one third would save more than one hundred fifty thousand strings of official cash each year."

sentences.zh: 世宗是其言。

translations.literal: Shizong approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong approved.

sentences.zh: 授戶部員外郎，條上便宜數事，世宗謂宰臣曰：「璣言河堤種柳可省每歲堤防之費，及言官錢利害，甚可取。

translations.literal: Appointed assistant director in the Ministry of Revenue, he submitted several items of practical benefit; Shizong told the chief ministers: "Ji says planting willows on river dikes can save yearly dike-defense costs, and his words on the profit and loss of official cash are very worth taking.
translations.idiomatic: As assistant director in the Ministry of Revenue he submitted several practical proposals. Shizong told his ministers, "Ji says planting willows on river dikes could cut annual dike costs, and his remarks on official cash are well worth heeding.

sentences.zh: 前後戶部官往往偷延歲月，如璣者不可多得，卿等議其可者行之。

translations.literal: Former Revenue officials often procrastinated month after month; men like Ji are hard to find—discuss what can be done and carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue officials before him often dragged their feet for months. Men like Ji are rare—discuss what can be adopted and put it into practice.

sentences.zh: 璣向言漕運省費事，盡心公家，不厚賞無以勸來者。」

translations.literal: Ji's earlier words on saving transport costs show wholehearted devotion to the public good; without generous reward there is no way to encourage those who follow."
translations.idiomatic: Ji's earlier proposal to cut transport costs shows real devotion to the public purse. Without a generous reward, who will follow his example?"

sentences.zh: 乃賜錢三千貫。

translations.literal: He was therefore granted three thousand strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: He was therefore granted three thousand strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 擢濰州刺史，徙知濟州。

translations.literal: Promoted to prefect of Weizhou, he was transferred to prefect of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to prefect of Weizhou, he was then transferred to prefect of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷同知北京留守事，坐曲法放免奴婢訴良者，左降管州刺史。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to vice commissioner of the Northern Capital garrison; for bending the law to release slaves and bondwomen who had brought freedom suits he was demoted to prefect of Guanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he became vice commissioner of the Northern Capital garrison, but was demoted to prefect of Guanzhou for bending the law to free slaves and bondwomen who had brought freedom suits.

sentences.zh: 世宗謂宰臣曰：「璣為人何如？」

translations.literal: Shizong asked the chief ministers: "What sort of man is Ji?"
translations.idiomatic: Shizong asked his ministers, "What sort of man is Ji?"

sentences.zh: 參知政事程輝曰：「璣執強跋扈，嘗追濟南府官錢，以至委曲生意而害及平民。」

translations.literal: Vice Grand Councilor Cheng Hui said: "Ji is overbearing and domineering; he once pursued official funds owed by Jinan Prefecture to such lengths that he twisted the facts and harmed common people."
translations.idiomatic: Vice Grand Councilor Cheng Hui said, "Ji is overbearing and domineering. When he pursued funds owed by Jinan Prefecture he twisted the facts so badly that common people suffered."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「朕聞璣在北京，凡奴隸訴良，不問契券真偽，輒放為良，意欲徼福於冥冥，則在己之奴何為不放？」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "I hear that in the Northern Capital, whenever slaves brought freedom suits Ji, without asking whether contracts were genuine or false, immediately released them as commoners, intending to seek merit in the unseen realm—then why did he not release his own slaves?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "I hear that in the Northern Capital, whenever slaves brought freedom suits Ji released them as commoners without checking whether their contracts were genuine, hoping to win merit in the unseen world—so why did he not free his own slaves?"

sentences.zh: 又曰：「璣放朕之家奴，意欲以此邀福，存心若是，不宜再用。」

translations.literal: He also said: "Ji released my household slaves, intending thereby to invite blessing—if his heart is like this, he should not be employed again."
translations.idiomatic: He added, "Ji freed my household slaves to court favor with Heaven. With a heart like that, he ought not be employed again."

sentences.zh: 明昌二年，入為國子司業，乞致仕不許，轉國子祭酒，尋擢太常卿，以昏耄不任職為御史台所糾罷。

translations.literal: In the second year of Mingchang he entered service as vice director of the Directorate of Education; he begged to retire but was not permitted; he was transferred to chancellor of the Directorate of Education, then promoted to minister of imperial sacrifices, and was impeached and dismissed by the Censorate as senile and unfit for office.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Mingchang he became vice director of the Directorate of Education. He asked to retire but was refused, was made chancellor of the Directorate, then minister of imperial sacrifices, and was finally impeached and removed by the Censorate as too senile to serve.

sentences.zh: 承安二年卒。

translations.literal: He died in the second year of Cheng'an.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second year of Cheng'an.

sentences.zh: 年八十二。

translations.literal: He was eighty-two.
translations.idiomatic: He was eighty-two years old.

sentences.zh: 兄珫。

translations.literal: His elder brother Chong.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother was Liu Chong.

sentences.zh: 兄 珫

translations.literal: Elder Brother Chong
translations.idiomatic: Elder Brother Chong

sentences.zh: 珫字伯玉，幼名太平。

translations.literal: Chong, styled Boyu, had the childhood name Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: Chong, styled Boyu, had the childhood name Taiping.

sentences.zh: 以功臣子補閣門祗候，遭父喪求終制，會海陵篡立，不許，改充護衛。

translations.literal: As the son of a meritorious official he was appointed gate usher; when his father died he sought to observe the full mourning period, but Hailing's usurpation occurred and this was not permitted; he was changed to serve as an imperial guardsman.
translations.idiomatic: As the son of a meritorious official he was appointed gate usher. When his father died he asked to observe full mourning, but Hailing's usurpation intervened and the request was denied; he was reassigned as an imperial guardsman.

sentences.zh: 海陵忌宗室，珫坐與往來，斥居鄉里。

translations.literal: Hailing was suspicious of the imperial clan; Chong, for associating with them, was expelled to live in the countryside.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing distrusted the imperial clan. Chong was banished to the countryside for keeping company with them.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，珫晝夜兼馳上謁，世宗大悅，以為護衛十人長。

translations.literal: When Shizong succeeded, Chong rode day and night to attend upon him; Shizong was greatly pleased and made him captain of ten imperial guardsmen.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong took the throne, Chong rode day and night to pay his respects. Delighted, Shizong made him captain of ten imperial guardsmen.

sentences.zh: 往招宗敘、白彥敬、紇石烈志寧，皆相繼來附。

translations.literal: Sent to summon Zongxu, Bai Yanjing, and Heshenlie Zhining, they all came in succession to join him.
translations.idiomatic: Sent to summon Zongxu, Bai Yanjing, and Heshenlie Zhining, he brought them in one after another to Shizong's side.

sentences.zh: 還報，上喜其有功，呼其小字而謂之曰：「太平所至，庶幾能贊朕致太平矣。」

translations.literal: On returning to report, the emperor, pleased with his merit, called him by his childhood name and said: "Wherever Taiping goes, he can perhaps help me bring about great peace."
translations.idiomatic: When he returned to report, the emperor, pleased with his service, called him by his childhood name and said, "Wherever Taiping goes, he may yet help me bring the realm to peace."

sentences.zh: 改禦院通進。

translations.literal: He was changed to director of communications for the Imperial Park.
translations.idiomatic: He was made director of communications for the Imperial Park.

sentences.zh: 與烏居仁等往南京發遣六宮百司，珫建議留尚書右丞紇石烈良弼經略淮右，餘皆北來，詔從之。

translations.literal: With Wu Juren and others he went to the Southern Capital to dispatch the inner palace and the hundred offices; Chong proposed leaving Right Vice Chancellor Heshenlie Liangbi to oversee the Huai region while the rest came north; the edict followed this.
translations.idiomatic: With Wu Juren and others he went to the Southern Capital to organize the departure of the inner palace and central offices. Chong proposed leaving Right Vice Chancellor Heshenlie Liangbi to oversee the Huai region while everyone else moved north, and the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，起複，三遷武庫署令。

translations.literal: When his mother died he was recalled from mourning to serve; through three promotions he became director of the Arsenal.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died he was recalled from mourning to serve again, and after three promotions became director of the Arsenal.

sentences.zh: 車駕幸西京，留珫為中都總管判官。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage visited the Western Capital, Chong was left behind as administrative judge of the Central Capital garrison.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor traveled to the Western Capital, Chong was left behind as administrative judge of the Central Capital garrison.

sentences.zh: 再轉近侍局使，遷太子少詹事，兼引進使，賜襲衣。

translations.literal: He was twice transferred to commissioner of the Inner Attendants Bureau, promoted to junior steward of the Heir Apparent, concurrently introduction commissioner, and granted court robes.
translations.idiomatic: He was twice transferred to commissioner of the Inner Attendants Bureau, promoted to junior steward of the Heir Apparent, concurrently introduction commissioner, and granted court robes.

sentences.zh: 未幾，為陝西統軍都監，賜廄馬、金帶，皇太子以馬與幣為贐。

translations.literal: Before long he was overall supervisor of the Shaanxi commandery army, granted stable horses and a gold belt; the crown prince gave horses and silks as parting gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was overall supervisor of the Shaanxi commandery army and granted stable horses and a gold belt; the crown prince gave horses and silks as parting gifts.

sentences.zh: 召為同知宣徽院事，遷太子詹事、右宣徽使，與張僅言典領昭德皇后園陵，襄事，太子贈以廄馬。

translations.literal: He was summoned as associate commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service, promoted to steward of the Heir Apparent and right commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service; together with Zhang Jinyan he directed the park tomb of Empress Zhaode and assisted in the funeral; the crown prince gave stable horses as gifts.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned as associate commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service, promoted to steward of the Heir Apparent and right commissioner of that service; with Zhang Jinyan he directed Empress Zhaode's park tomb and assisted at her funeral; the crown prince gave him stable horses.

sentences.zh: 轉左宣徽使，以疾求補外，除定海軍節度使，以其弟太府監瑋為同知宣徽院事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to left commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service; for illness he sought an outside post and was made military commissioner of the Dinghai Army; his younger brother Wei, director of the Imperial Treasury, was made associate commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service.
translations.idiomatic: He became left commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service. Ill, he sought an outside post and was made military commissioner of the Dinghai Army; his younger brother Wei, director of the Imperial Treasury, was made associate commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service.

sentences.zh: 珫朝辭，上曰：「卿舊臣，今補外，寧不惻然。

translations.literal: At court leave Chong said: "You are an old minister; now sent outside—are you not sorrowful?
translations.idiomatic: At his farewell audience Chong was told, "You are an old minister; now sent outside—surely you feel sorrow.

sentences.zh: 東萊瀕海，風物亦佳，卿到必得調養。

translations.literal: Donglai borders the sea and its scenery is also fine—you will surely be able to recuperate there.
translations.idiomatic: Donglai borders the sea and the scenery is fine—you will surely recover your health there.

sentences.zh: 朕用卿弟在近密，如見卿也。」

translations.literal: I employ your younger brother in close attendance, as if seeing you."
translations.idiomatic: I keep your younger brother close at hand—it is as if I still see you."

sentences.zh: 仍賜廄馬、金帶、彩十端、絹百匹。

translations.literal: He was still granted stable horses, a gold belt, ten bolts of colored silk, and one hundred bolts of plain silk.
translations.idiomatic: He was also granted stable horses, a gold belt, ten bolts of colored silk, and one hundred bolts of plain silk.

sentences.zh: 卒官，年五十七。

translations.literal: He died in office, aged fifty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office at the age of fifty-seven.

sentences.zh: 珫柩過京畿，敕有司致祭，賻銀三百兩、重彩三十端。

translations.literal: When Chong's coffin passed through the capital region, an edict ordered the authorities to perform sacrifices and granted three hundred taels of silver and thirty bolts of heavy colored silk as funeral gifts.
translations.idiomatic: When Chong's coffin passed through the capital region, the authorities were ordered to perform sacrifices, and three hundred taels of silver and thirty bolts of heavy colored silk were granted for his funeral.

sentences.zh: 康元弼

translations.literal: Kang Yuanbi
translations.idiomatic: Kang Yuanbi

sentences.zh: 康元弼，字輔之，大同雲中人。

translations.literal: Kang Yuanbi, style name Fuzhi, was a native of Yunzhong in Datong.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Yuanbi, whose style name was Fuzhi, came from Yunzhong in Datong.

sentences.zh: 幼敏學，善屬文，登正隆二年進士第。

translations.literal: From youth he was quick in study and skilled in composition; he passed the jinshi examination in the second year of Zhenlong.
translations.idiomatic: He was quick to learn from youth and skilled at composition; he passed the jinshi examination in the second year of Zhenlong.

sentences.zh: 調汝陽簿，改崇義軍節度判官。

translations.literal: He was appointed registrar of Ruyang and changed to military judge of the Chongyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed registrar of Ruyang and then military judge of the Chongyi Army.

sentences.zh: 由垣曲縣令補尚書省令史，累遷同知河北西路轉運使事，召為大理丞。

translations.literal: From magistrate of Yuanqu he filled a clerkship in the Secretariat, was repeatedly promoted to associate director of transport on the Hebei West Circuit, and was summoned as vice director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: From magistrate of Yuanqu he took a Secretariat clerkship, rose to associate director of transport on the Hebei West Circuit, and was summoned as vice director of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 大定二十七年，河決曹、濮間，瀕水者多墊溺，朝延遣元弼往視，相其地如盎，而城在盎中，水易為害，請命於朝以徙之，卒改築于北原，曹人賴焉。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Dading the Yellow River broke its banks between Cao and Pu; many along the water drowned; the court sent Yuanbi to inspect; he found the terrain like a bowl and the city inside the bowl, where water easily did harm, and requested court orders to move it; in the end it was rebuilt on the northern plain, and the people of Cao relied on this.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year of Dading the Yellow River burst between Cao and Pu and many along the banks drowned. The court sent Yuanbi to inspect the site. He found the terrain bowl-shaped with the city inside it, where flood easily did harm, and requested permission to relocate it. The city was eventually rebuilt on the northern plain, to Cao's great benefit.

sentences.zh: 出為弘州刺史，閱歲授大理少卿。

translations.literal: He went out as prefect of Hong Prefecture; after a year he was appointed vice director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as prefect of Hong Prefecture; after a year he was appointed vice director of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 先是，衛州為河所壞，增築蘇門以寓州治。

translations.literal: Earlier Weizhou had been destroyed by the river and Sumen was enlarged to house the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Weizhou had been destroyed by the river and Sumen was enlarged to serve as the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 水既退，民不樂遷，欲複歸衛，於是遣元弼按視，還言治故城便，遂複其舊。

translations.literal: When the water had receded the people were unwilling to move and wished to return to Wei; Yuanbi was then sent to inspect and on his return said governing the old city was convenient, and the old seat was restored.
translations.idiomatic: When the water receded the people were unwilling to remain and wished to return to Wei. Yuanbi was sent to inspect and reported that governing the old city was preferable; the old seat was restored.

sentences.zh: 轉秘書少監，兼著作郎，改通州刺史，兼領漕事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice director of the Secretariat, concurrently editing director, changed to prefect of Tong Prefecture, and concurrently directed transport affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice director of the Secretariat with concurrent charge as editing director, made prefect of Tong Prefecture, and concurrently directed transport affairs.

sentences.zh: 章宗立，尊孝懿皇后為皇太后，以元弼舊臣詔充副衛尉。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhangzong took the throne, Empress Xiaoyi was honored as empress dowager; Yuanbi as an old minister was ordered to serve as deputy commandant of the Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhangzong succeeded, Empress Xiaoyi was honored as empress dowager, and Yuanbi, as an old minister, was ordered to serve as deputy commandant of the Imperial Guard.

sentences.zh: 再轉大理卿，以喪去，起複為尚書刑部侍郎，兼鄆王傅，遷南京路轉運使。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to director of the Court of Judicial Review, left on mourning, recalled from mourning as vice minister of punishments in the Secretariat, concurrently tutor to the Prince of Yan, and moved to director of transport on the Nanjing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was again made director of the Court of Judicial Review, left on mourning, recalled as vice minister of punishments with concurrent tutorship of the Prince of Yan, and moved to director of transport on the Nanjing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 承安三年致仕，卒。

translations.literal: He retired in the third year of Cheng'an and died.
translations.idiomatic: He retired in the third year of Cheng'an and died.

sentences.zh: 移剌益

translations.literal: Yila Yi
translations.idiomatic: Yila Yi

sentences.zh: 移剌益，字子遷，本名特末阿不，中都路胡魯土猛安人也。

translations.literal: Yila Yi, style name Ziqian, original name Temu Abu, was a native of the Hulutu garrison in the Zhongdu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Yila Yi, whose style name was Ziqian and whose original name was Temu Abu, came from the Hulutu garrison in the Zhongdu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 以廕補國史院書寫，積勞調徐州錄事，召為樞密院知法，三遷翰林修撰。

translations.literal: By yin privilege he entered as scribe of the Historiography Institute; through accumulated service he was appointed recorder of Xuzhou, summoned as legal specialist of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and three times promoted to Hanlin editing director.
translations.idiomatic: He entered through yin privilege as scribe of the Historiography Institute, rose through service to recorder of Xuzhou, was summoned as legal specialist of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and was three times promoted to Hanlin editing director.

sentences.zh: 時北邊有警，詔百官集尚書省議之，太尉克甯銳意用兵，益言天時未利，宜俟後圖。

translations.literal: At the time there was alarm on the northern frontier; an edict assembled officials at the Secretariat to discuss it; Grand Marshal Kening was keen to use troops; Yi said the season was not favorable and one should wait for a later plan.
translations.idiomatic: When the northern frontier was alarmed, officials were assembled at the Secretariat. Grand Marshal Kening was eager for war; Yi said the season was not favorable and plans should wait.

sentences.zh: 御史台舉益剛正可任，遂兼監察御史。

translations.literal: The Censorate recommended Yi as upright and fit for appointment, and he was concurrently made investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate recommended Yi as upright and fit for office, and he was concurrently made investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 未幾，改戶部員外郎。

translations.literal: Before long he was changed to vice director of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was made vice director of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 明昌三年，畿內饑，擢授霸州刺史，同授刺史者十一人，既入謝，詔諭之曰：「親民之職，惟在守令，比歲民饑，故遣卿等往撫育之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Mingchang there was famine within the capital region; he was promoted and appointed prefect of Bazhou; eleven men were appointed prefect together; after entering to give thanks, an edict instructed them: "The office closest to the people lies in prefects and magistrates; in recent years the people have been hungry, so we send you to nurture them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Mingchang famine struck the capital region. Yi was promoted to prefect of Bazhou along with ten others. After they gave thanks, an edict told them, "Prefects and magistrates are closest to the people. Because of recent famine we send you to nurture them.

sentences.zh: 其資序有過者有弗及者，朕不計此，但以材選，爾其知之。」

translations.literal: Some exceed others in seniority and some fall short—I do not reckon this; I choose only by talent—know this."
translations.idiomatic: Some of you outrank others in seniority and some fall short—I disregard that and choose only by talent. Know this well."

sentences.zh: 既至，首出俸粟以食饑者，於是倅以下及郡人遞出粟以佐之，且命屬縣視以為法，多所全活。

translations.literal: On arrival he first contributed salary grain to feed the hungry; then deputies and below and people of the commandery in turn contributed grain to assist, and he ordered subordinate counties to take this as a model—many lives were preserved.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he first gave salary grain to feed the hungry. Deputies and county people followed with grain of their own, and he ordered subordinate counties to follow the example—many lives were saved.

sentences.zh: 郡東南有堤久頹圮，水屢為害，益增修之，民以為便，為益立祠。

translations.literal: Southeast of the commandery was a dike long in ruins; water repeatedly did harm; Yi enlarged and repaired it; the people found it convenient and erected a shrine to Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast of the commandery a dike had long lain in ruins and floods had repeatedly done harm. Yi repaired and strengthened it; the people were pleased and erected a shrine in his honor.

sentences.zh: 升遼東路提刑副使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to deputy surveillance commissioner of the Liaodong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to deputy surveillance commissioner of the Liaodong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 五年，宋主新立，詔以泗州當使客所經，守臣宜擇人，宰臣進擬數人，皆不合上意，上曰：「特末阿不安在？

translations.literal: In the fifth year a new Song emperor took the throne; an edict said that Sizhou would lie on the envoys' route and the defending official should be carefully chosen; the chief ministers proposed several men, none fitting the emperor's mind; the emperor said: "Where is Temu Abu?
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year a new Song emperor succeeded. An edict noted that Sizhou lay on the envoys' route and required a careful choice of defender. Several candidates proposed by the chief ministers displeased the emperor, who said, "Where is Temu Abu?

sentences.zh: 此人可也。」

translations.literal: This man will do."
translations.idiomatic: This man will do."

sentences.zh: 即授防禦使。

translations.literal: He was immediately appointed defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was immediately appointed defense commissioner.

sentences.zh: 召為尚書戶部侍郎，尋轉兵部。

translations.literal: He was summoned as vice minister of revenue in the Secretariat and soon transferred to the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned as vice minister of revenue in the Secretariat and soon transferred to the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 屬群牧人叛，命益同殿前都點檢兗往招降之。

translations.literal: When the pastoral tribes rebelled, Yi was ordered together with Yan, overall commander of the Palace Front, to go and win them over.
translations.idiomatic: When pastoral tribes rebelled, Yi was ordered together with Yan, overall commander of the Palace Front, to go and win them over.

sentences.zh: 承安二年，邊鄙弗寧，上禦便殿，召朝官四品以上入議，益謂「守為便。

translations.literal: In the second year of Cheng'an the frontier was unsettled; the emperor held court in the side hall and summoned officials of fourth rank and above to discuss; Yi said: "Defense is the convenient course.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Cheng'an the frontier was unsettled. The emperor met officials of fourth rank and above in the side hall. Yi said, "Defense is the better course.

sentences.zh: 天子之兵當取萬全，若王師輕出，少有不利，非惟損大國之威，恐啟敵人侵玩之心。」

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven's army should take complete security; if the royal army goes out lightly and meets even a little adversity, it will not only diminish the great state's prestige but may also open the enemy's heart to encroachment."
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven's army must seek complete security. If the imperial army marches out lightly and meets even small setbacks, it will diminish the state's prestige and may embolden the enemy."

sentences.zh: 出為山東西路轉運使。

translations.literal: He was sent out as director of transport on the Shandong West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as director of transport on the Shandong West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 有敕使按鷹于山東，益奏：「乞止令調於近甸，何必驚遠方耳目。」

translations.literal: An edict envoy was inspecting hawks in Shandong; Yi memorialized: "I beg that collection be limited to the near districts—why startle distant regions?"
translations.idiomatic: An edict envoy was collecting hawks in Shandong. Yi memorialized, "I beg that collection be limited to the near districts—why alarm distant regions?"

sentences.zh: 書聞，上命有司治使者罪。

translations.literal: When the memorial was received, the emperor ordered the authorities to punish the envoy.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was received, the emperor ordered the envoy punished.

sentences.zh: 遷河東南北路按察使。

translations.literal: He was moved to surveillance commissioner of the Hedong North and South circuits.
translations.idiomatic: He was moved to surveillance commissioner of the Hedong North and South circuits.

sentences.zh: 舊制，在位官有不任職，委所屬上司體訪。

translations.literal: By old regulation, when an incumbent was unfit for office, investigation was entrusted to his immediate superior.
translations.idiomatic: Under old regulations, when an incumbent was unfit for office, investigation was entrusted to his immediate superior.

sentences.zh: 州府長貳幕職，許互相舉申。

translations.literal: Prefectural chiefs, deputies, and staff were permitted to impeach one another.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural chiefs, deputies, and staff were permitted to impeach one another.

sentences.zh: 益上言以為：「傷禮讓之風，亦恐同官因之不睦，別生奸弊。

translations.literal: Yi memorialized that this: "injures the wind of courtesy and yielding, and I also fear colleagues will for this be ill at ease and separately give rise to wicked abuses.
translations.idiomatic: Yi memorialized that this "injures the spirit of courtesy and yielding and may make colleagues ill at ease and breed fresh abuses.

sentences.zh: 乞止令按察司糾劾，似為得體」。

translations.literal: I beg that only the surveillance office be allowed to impeach—that seems the proper form."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that only the surveillance office be allowed to impeach—that seems the proper form."

sentences.zh: 又言：「隨路點軍官與富人飲會，公通獻遺，宜依准監臨官於所部內犯罪究治。」

translations.literal: He also said: "Circuit army inspectors who drink and feast with the wealthy and openly exchange gifts should, in accordance with the law on supervising officials who commit crimes within their jurisdiction, be investigated and punished."
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Circuit army inspectors who feast with the wealthy and exchange gifts openly should be investigated and punished under the law governing supervising officials who offend within their jurisdiction."

sentences.zh: 上皆納焉。

translations.literal: The emperor adopted all of these.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor adopted all of these proposals.

sentences.zh: 泰和二年，卒於官。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taihe he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Taihe he died in office.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：閻公貞定金律令，楊伯元定金推排，人皆以平稱之，難矣。

translations.literal: Appreciation: Yan Gongzhen fixed the Jin code statutes, Yang Boyuan fixed the Jin household survey regulations—people all called them fair; that is hard indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Appreciation: Yan Gongzhen fixed the Jin code statutes and Yang Boyuan fixed the Jin household survey regulations—both were called fair, which is no small praise.

sentences.zh: 焦旭畿內小官，聽斷不受御史風指，遂罹深憲。

translations.literal: Jiao Xu was a minor official within the capital region; in hearing cases he did not bend to censorial pressure and therefore fell under severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Jiao Xu was a minor official in the capital region who would not bend his judgments to censorial pressure and therefore suffered severe punishment.

sentences.zh: 大臣請人主遊獵，劾奏其非，為之罷獵，誠有古人之風焉。

translations.literal: When great ministers asked the ruler to go hunting, he impeached the impropriety and hunting was canceled—truly there was the air of the ancients about it.
translations.idiomatic: When great ministers asked the ruler to go hunting, he impeached the impropriety and the hunt was canceled—truly in the manner of the ancients.

sentences.zh: 李完、康元弼無他足稱，完論台令史一事，元弼論曹、衛兩城，各當其可。

translations.literal: Li Wan and Kang Yuanbi have nothing else especially praiseworthy; Wan on the Censorate clerk matter and Yuanbi on the Cao and Wei two cities—each hit what was fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wan and Kang Yuanbi have little else especially praiseworthy; Wan on the Censorate clerk matter and Yuanbi on the Cao and Wei relocations—each was right where it mattered.

sentences.zh: 馬百祿初坐黨廢，晚著治跡。

translations.literal: Ma Bailu was at first dismissed for party affiliation and in later years showed administrative achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Bailu was at first dismissed for party affiliation and in later years showed real administrative achievement.

sentences.zh: 劉璣初以理財得幸，晚以曲法得罪，人有前後遭遇不同，而百祿求福不回，非璣所及也。

translations.literal: Liu Ji at first won favor through fiscal management and in later years offended through bending the law; men meet with different fortunes before and after, yet Bailu sought blessing without wavering—something Ji could not match.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ji at first won favor through fiscal management and later offended through bending the law. Fortune differs, yet Bailu sought blessing without wavering—something Ji could not match.

sentences.zh: 劉珫以大定之立馳赴行在，雖終身榮寵，蓋一趨時之士耳。

translations.literal: Liu Chong, when Dading was established, galloped day and night to the mobile court; though he enjoyed honor to the end of his life, he was essentially a man who rushed with the times.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chong galloped day and night to Shizong's mobile court when Dading was established; though honored for life, he was essentially a man who rushed with the times.

sentences.zh: 劉仲洙剛而訥於言，移剌益剛而敢言。

translations.literal: Liu Zhongzhu was firm yet slow of speech; Yila Yi was firm yet daring in speech.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhongzhu was firm yet slow of speech; Yila Yi was firm yet daring in speech.

sentences.zh: 益以志寧北伐為不可，仲洙釋田玨黨禍三十家。

translations.literal: Yi held Zhining's northern campaign impracticable; Zhongzhu released the party calamity of thirty households of Tian Jue.
translations.idiomatic: Yi held Zhining's northern campaign impracticable; Zhongzhu cleared the party punishment of thirty households tied to Tian Jue.

sentences.zh: 《語》曰：「剛毅木訥近仁。」

translations.literal: The Analects says: "Firm, resolute, plain, and slow of speech are close to humaneness."
translations.idiomatic: The Analects says, "Firm, resolute, plain, and slow of speech are close to humaneness."

sentences.zh: 豈不信哉！

translations.literal: Can this not be believed!
translations.idiomatic: Can this not be believed!
